claim: Tumour spheroids are common in vitro experimental models of avascular tumour growth.
source: Tumour spheroids are common in vitro experimental models of avascular tumour growth.

source: Compared with traditional two-dimensional culture, tumour spheroids more closely mimic the avascular tumour microenvironment where spatial differences in nutrient availability strongly influence growth.
evidence: This statement is supported by citation to Mark et al., 2020 in the introduction.

claim: Avascular tumours have a limiting structure.

claim: The limiting structure can be independent of seeding density.
source: the limiting structure can be independent of seeding density
